lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Barnaby. Last night I looked at the <color=red>stars</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I made three <color=red>riddles</color> about space. Get them right, and three new books go to the library!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Now, where did I put them? Oh! They are in my hat.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 1: I am big and hot. I <color=red>shine</color> in the day. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What makes the day bright and warm?

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 2: I come out at <color=red>night</color>. Sometimes I am round. Sometimes I am thin. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What do you see in the sky at night?
lines.correctText: That is right! I am the moon.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 3: I have a pointy nose. I <color=red>zoom</color> up into space. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What can go up into space?
lines.correctText: Well done! I am a rocket.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Three out of three! You are so <color=red>clever</color>. Three new books are going to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Thank you for doing my riddles. Look up at the <color=red>sky</color> tonight!
